description: This file defines an interface for responses related to a Thing Search command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies methods and default behaviors for such responses, including resource type and headers.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface for responses to Thing Search commands, providing default implementations for resource path, type, and header setting.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for the response, defaulting to an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string specific to Thing Search commands.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers in the response and returns the modified response object.
